responsibility: Implements the shared utility layer for Rust AST-to-HIR lowering. Beyond providing no-op default AST visitor methods for the many node kinds that specialized lowerers override, this file owns reusable lowering helpers for literals, lifetimes and qualifiers, tuple and range pattern pieces, extern blocks, and outer-attribute handling such as lang items, doc attributes, builtin-attribute filtering, and pass ownership checks. It is the common support code that allocates HIR nodes, creates NodeMapping/HirId/DefId entries, emits attribute diagnostics, and feeds the central HIR mapping tables used by the rest of the lowering subsystem.
same_name_distinction: Implements the out-of-line behavior for the base lowering layer declared in rust-ast-lower-base.h: default no-op AST visitor methods plus shared helper function bodies for attribute handling, literal/lifetime/pattern-piece lowering, extern-block lowering, and mapping insertion.
